notes: Codex does not report cache writes; input not read from cache is priced as uncached input.
GPT-6.1 Sol bills the whole request at the long-context price when one request's input exceeds 272K tokens. The long-context cache read price was not given and stays null, so such tokens fail closed.
Claude Code reports cache writes with a 1h or 5m split; an unsplit write has no price and fails closed.
GPT-6 Astra uses the same 272K long-context rule as GPT-6.1 Sol. Codex does not report cache writes, so the Astra cache write prices are not used and stay null like Sol's.
GPT-6.1 Terra uses the same 272K long-context rule as GPT-6.1 Sol. Codex does not report cache writes, so the Terra cache write prices are not used and stay null like Sol's.
ArgonのCLI total_tokensはキャッシュ読み取りを除く。一次記録の未キャッシュ入力・キャッシュ読み取り・思考を内包した出力を合算する。
source: Standard API prices as of 2026-10-09 provided by the user (OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol and Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5.5 pricing pages). GPT-6 Astra added on 2026-10-10 from the OpenAI API pricing page (developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, standard tier): input $10, cached input $1, cache write $12.50, output $50; over 272K input tokens: input $20, cached input $2, cache write $25, output $75. GPT-6.1 Terra added on 2026-10-27 from the OpenAI API pricing page (developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, standard tier): input $1, cached input $0.05, 30m cache write $1.25, output $5; over 272K input tokens: input $2, cached input $0.10, 30m cache write $2.50, output $7.50. Claude Fable 5.2の追加根拠（2026-11-10確認）: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-2/overview 。100万トークン当たり入力8 USD、出力40 USD、キャッシュ読み取り0.20 USD、5分書き込み10 USD、1時間書き込み16 USD。 Gemini 4 Argon追加根拠（2026-11-11）: https://aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing#gemini-4-argon 。2026-11-30までの標準API換算単価。入力2 USD、キャッシュ読み取り0.10 USD、思考を含む出力10 USD/100万トークン。Antigravityのサブスクリプション請求額ではない。CLIのgemini-4-argon-lowは同じAPIモデルの低推論設定として対応づける。
